summary: Iteration 45 - Virtus per-day calendar + journal feature. Backend: all 8 pytest tests passed (auth required, get plan shape, per-date check-in isolation, bad date 400, bad goal 404, per-date journal isolation, clearing journal removes key, persistence). Frontend: full UI flow verified on mobile viewport (390x844) using a pre-minted premium session token injected into localStorage. Calendar day strip renders correctly (8 chips for a 7-day plan), today is highlighted (gold bar), future days are dimmed and goal toggles are disabled on them (verified clicking a future-day goal did NOT change days_logged). Goal toggle for selected day updates checkins and the 'Y/Z today' pill in real time. Per-day journal isolation works: TEST text saved for today, switching to tomorrow shows empty input, switching back shows the saved text. Save button labels correctly toggle between 'Save reflection' / 'Saved'. Delete plan flow: cross-platform confirm dialog (window.confirm on web) was accepted by Playwright and the backend returned 404 for the deleted plan afterwards (router.back() is a no-op only when the screen is opened directly via URL, not a real-user issue).

issues: Pluralization: stats pill shows '1 days logged' instead of '1 day logged'. Minor copy issue in summary card.

action_items: OPTIONAL: pluralize 'X day(s) logged' in /app/frontend/app/virtus/plan/[id].tsx line 211 (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: _shape_plan.completed counts only goal_ids that still exist in plan.goals — good defensive logic against orphaned checkins.
Future-day disabling is enforced in two places: Pressable disabled prop AND a guard in toggle() (isFuture). Good.
saveJournal also fires on onBlur AND on save button press — both dedup via journalDirty flag. Solid UX.
Backend correctly validates YYYY-MM-DD via strptime; bad goal_id returns 404; empty journal text removes the date key (storage tidy).
Per-date check-in toggle works idempotently (add/remove); empty list removes the date key.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted plan vp_24c3a9536cde (patience, 7 days) for UI testing. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To bypass Emergent Google sign-in on web for testing, navigate to the app root first, then `await page.evaluate(...)` to set localStorage key 'sanctus_session_token' to JSON.stringify('<pre-minted token>'); also push the same key/value into IndexedDB 'RKStorage' -> 'catalystLocalStorage' (the AsyncStorage web shim). After that, direct navigation to /virtus/plan/{id} works.
